name: Explosion Light Spill & Camera Flinch
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Bake practical explosion VFX directly into surrounding physics: `violent orange fireball blooms across wet brick, blinding light spill flickering across nearby windows, thick black smoke billowing upward, camera flinches slightly from concussive shockwave`.

name: Swirling Energy & Dynamic Light Cast
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Describe both effect AND surface interaction: `swirling sapphire arcane filaments orbit hovering fingers, casting pulsing blue highlights across cheek bones, metallic armor seams, and dark cave mist`.

name: Translucent Hologram & Hand Spill
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Ground sci-fi VFX cleanly: `translucent cyan wireframe hologram rotating smoothly above dark desk, subtle scanline flicker, cool teal glow reflecting sharply on brass fingertips and cornea`.

name: Ash & Glowing Ember Disintegration
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Prompt progressive erosion cleanly: `outer stone armor cracks open revealing orange fissures before crumbling smoothly into fine dark ash and wind-swept glowing embers drifting backward`.

name: Sonic Shockwave Ring & Air Refraction
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Describe concentric refractive wave expansion: `visible transparent shockwave hemisphere blasts outward flattening tall grass radial-wise and scattering rooftop dust clouds instantaneously`.

name: Thunderstorm Lightning Sheet Flash
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Time atmospheric strobe beats cleanly: `bruised indigo storm clouds hang dark over ridges. A sudden forked lightning arc flashes inside clouds, briefly illuminating jagged snowy crags in stark ice-white light`.

name: Swirling Autumn Leaf Wind Vortex
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Track curved eddies rather than random speckles: `crisp bronze maple leaves whip upward from wet slate steps, spiraling cleanly around coat hems in warm sunlit backlight`.

name: Horizontal Blizzard Gust & Squint
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Drive coherent wind vector across all props: `horizontal gale blasts powdery spindrift snow sideways past frozen hood fur, frosted wool coat whipping right as traveler shields eyes`.

name: Basalt Sea-Stack Wave Crash & Mist
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Describe towering hydrodynamic collision: `massive slate Atlantic swell slams against black basalt sea cliffs, sending white sunlit spray curtains soaring twenty meters into misty coastal wind`.

name: Evolving Sunrise Shadow & Alpenglow
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Animate subtle sun elevation shifts over scenic anchors: `warm rose-amber dawn sunlight creeps slowly downward across snow ridges, turning icy blue shadow faces luminous gold`.

name: Accelerating Cumulonimbus Cloud Boil
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep distant mountain silhouettes steady while `towering bronze-tinted storm clouds churn and mushroom majestically upward, wispy anvil edges catching golden sunset`.

name: Steam Engine Pistons & Dense Exhaust
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Couple mechanical steel linkage to billowing exhaust: `polished connecting rods drive synchronized steel wheels forward while thick warm sunlit white steam plumes blast violently upward`.

name: Draft-Bending Candle Flame & Curl
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Focus macro optics closely on delicate flame physics: `tall golden candle flame bends sharply sideward under a sudden cool draft, stretching glowing soot trail over brass holder`.

name: High-Speed Glass & Crystal Shatter
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Use `extreme 240fps slow motion capture`: spidery silver stress fractures race radially from impact center before faceted crystal shards tumble glinting slowly through dramatic side backlight.

name: Submerged Buoyant Bubble Streams
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Layer depth cleanly underwater: `silver air bubbles wobble upward fracturing bright surface caustic rays while loose hair and tunic sleeves billow lazily in slow water drag`.

name: Molten Magma Crust & Convection Shimmer
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Contrast cooling dark jagged basalt crusts cracking apart to expose viscous bright orange molten seams radiating visible rising heat shimmer and floating embers.

name: Wind-Driven Saharan Dune Spindrift
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Animate razor-sharp ochre sand dune crests cleanly: `translucent plumes of golden sand whip sharply like smoke off windward dune knife-edges under low afternoon backlight`.

name: Macro Ink Bloom & Fluid Vortices
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Frame macro `100mm f/2.8 backlit crystal tank`: dense obsidian and crimson ink plumes descend gracefully, blooming outward into delicate curling Kelvin-Helmholtz fluid filaments.

name: Shivering Emerald Aurora Curtains
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep snowy spruce silhouettes motionless below while `luminous emerald and violet aurora borealis curtains ripple overhead across crisp starry zenith, faintly tinting snow ice green`.

name: Bioluminescent Fireflies & Bokeh Spores
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Send gentle curving golden-green firefly blinks gliding lazily across cool misty woodland reeds, blooming into soft bokeh orbs as individuals cross near lens.

name: Macro Ice Feather Crystallization
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Accelerate crisp dendritic growth across window panes: `feathery frost needles shoot swiftly across cool backlit glass turning transparent condensation into etched frozen lace`.

name: Shorting Neon Sign Spark & Buzz
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Coordinate electrical drop beat: `pink glass kanji tube flickers erratically in rain, dropping briefly dark with tiny blue wire sparks before buzzing back onto wet puddles`.

name: Dense Colored Tactical Smoke Roll
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Drive volumetric heavy smoke billowing densely upward from sizzling canister on wet concrete, swallowing boots first while backlit streetlamps sculpt swirling volumetric cloud edges.

name: Horizon Heat Shimmer Over Asphalt
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Shoot down `200mm compressed desert highway perspective` where fierce undulating air convection warps distant horizon silhouettes above shimmering wet-looking false mirage asphalt.

name: Steel Angle-Grinder Arc & Ricochet
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Spray `incandescent yellow-white sparks arcing rapidly in sharp parabolic jets across dark garage floor`, bouncing sharply off concrete and glowing warmly across leather gloves.
